name: typography
import: import { Heading, Link, Text, setLineClamp } from '@absoluteui/components/typography';
purpose: Token-based typography as CSS classes that work without JavaScript (aui-heading--1..6, aui-text and modifiers, aui-link, aui-code, aui-prose, aui-truncate, aui-line-clamp), plus validated JS helpers: headings whose semantic level is independent of visual size, links restricted to http(s) and relative URLs that announce when they open a new tab, and a validated line clamp.
whenToUse: Headings, body text, and supporting text that must follow the theme's type scale.
Links inside content, including links that open in a new tab.
Rich text from a CMS or Markdown renderer (aui-prose), after sanitization.
Truncating long single-line labels or clamping previews to a number of lines.
whenNotToUse: Actions that do not navigate: use a Button.
Code blocks that need syntax highlighting: use a dedicated highlighter inside aui-prose pre.
Truncating essential information that users cannot otherwise reach.
responsive: Sizes are rem-based tokens, so text scales with user font settings. Long words wrap (overflow-wrap). aui-truncate needs a constrained inline size; aui-line-clamp clamps to --aui-lines (default 3).
rtl: Logical properties throughout: prose list indentation and blockquote rule sit at the inline start; ellipsis appears at the inline end.
theme: font-family-*, font-size-*, font-weight-*, line-height-* tokens; color-text, color-text-muted, color-link, color-surface-sunken (code). Forced-colors mode renders links in LinkText with a Highlight focus outline; inline code keeps a visible border.
security: All helpers set text with textContent. Link.create validates href with the WHATWG URL parser and accepts only http(s) or relative references; javascript:, data:, vbscript:, file:, blob:, and obfuscated forms are rejected. External links get rel="noopener noreferrer". setLineClamp writes one custom property through the CSSOM. aui-prose styles markup but does not sanitize it: sanitize untrusted HTML with the core sanitizer first. CSP-safe.
dataHandling: No persistence, network access, or telemetry.

performance.testedScale: Helpers create one element each and attach no listeners or subscriptions. Not yet part of the e2e performance suite.

limitations: The external-link hint is resolved at creation time; later locale changes do not update existing links.
aui-line-clamp relies on -webkit-line-clamp (supported by all current engines); the standard line-clamp property is declared for forward compatibility.
aui-prose styles only p, ul, ol, li, h2 to h4, a, code, pre, and blockquote.
No external-link icon; the hint is text for assistive technology only.
unsupported: HTML strings as heading, text, or link text.
Non-http(s) link schemes such as mailto: or tel: in Link.create (use a plain <a class="aui-link"> for those).
antiPatterns: Choosing a heading level for its size; use size to change appearance and keep the outline correct.
Removing the link underline; color alone does not identify links (WCAG 1.4.1).
Opening links in a new tab without telling the user.
Clamping or truncating text without another way to read it in full.

adapters.angular: No directive: use the CSS classes (aui-heading, aui-text, aui-link, ...) in Angular templates and the JS helpers from @absoluteui/components/typography.
adapters.react: No component: use the CSS classes and `isSafeHref` from @absoluteui/components/typography (docs/REACT.md).
adapters.vue: No component: use the CSS classes and `isSafeHref` from @absoluteui/components/typography (docs/VUE.md).
